text: Why did the skeleton stay at home? He had no body to go with!
instructions: Perform as a cuddly, sleepy little pumpkin monster in a children's story, with a British English accent. Use a softly gravelly, rounded, gently dopey cartoon voice and a leisurely drowsy rhythm for the question. Pause, then perk up with goofy excitement and a smile for the punchline. Make the contrast funny and endearing. Keep the gravel subtle and the speech clear; no threatening growls, whispering or sudden loudness. Say only the supplied words, no extra dialogue, laughter, yawns or sound effects.
